findings.symptom: Malformed submit_policy values are accepted for native-disabled inputs.
findings.reproduction: Copy booking-id candidate; set availability to native-disabled and submit_policy to [], {}, true, 0, null, or incldue.
findings.evidence: All six returned findings=[] in critic-probe-results.json; valid include without separate serialization correctly rejected.
findings.impact: Violates frozen oracle 11 fail-closed; malformed serialization declarations can bypass disabled-value-loss check.
findings.correction: Validate submit_policy type and supported values before semantic branching; require policy where appropriate.
findings.recheck: Six malformed variants rejected; valid include controls preserved.

findings.symptom: All non-AssertionError exceptions, including interaction failures after successful startup, become BLOCKED.
findings.reproduction: Static control-flow inspection: a locator TimeoutError raised during case execution reaches the blanket Exception handler. No browser runtime reproduction performed.
findings.evidence: Source has one blanket exception handler with status BLOCKED across setup and all interactions.
findings.impact: Product regression can be mislabeled as environment inability, weakening evidence passed to D.
findings.correction: Separate setup/environment failures from loaded-page interaction/script/locator failures; classify the latter FAIL or ERROR with phase/case.
findings.recheck: Only setup is BLOCKED; navigation/interaction/unknown produce ERROR_TEST_EXECUTION; phase/case recorded; exit 1 for execution errors. Main not called.

findings.symptom: After committing a new slot, reopened dialog still shows the original before date.
findings.reproduction: Run actual extracted application script in minimal Node doubles: open, choose December 10, confirm, reopen.
findings.evidence: Initial result current=December 10 but fixed beforeMarkup=December 8.
findings.impact: Repeated use misrepresents the already committed value; count-only tests miss the stale view.
findings.correction: Render current and dialog before value from one committed state.
findings.recheck: Both fields show December 10 after reopen.

findings.symptom: Close handler checks invoker availability but never checks actual restoration result required by the registry.
findings.reproduction: Supply body as activeElement while invoker is connected, enabled and visible; invoke actual close handler.
findings.evidence: Initial model probe observed no fallback call. This proves a missing branch only, not a UA failure.
findings.impact: Implementation does not realize its claimed restoration-result contract when focus is lost despite an available invoker.
findings.correction: Observe actual focus, preserve valid restoration/external focus, and attempt a targeted recovery only when needed.
findings.recheck: Supplied lost focus rescued; removed invoker fallback and valid external focus preserved in doubles.
